title: [US] TSP-Seller Service Online Signing Process

html:
Introduction: What is Seller Service Online Signing?

Seller Service Online Signing is a feature that allows TSPs to establish online signing relationships with sellers.

What are the benefits？

  • Smoother Workflow: TSPs can initiate a single or multiple service proposal, which the seller can then review and confirm.
  • Official Signing: By detailing service specifics and related information, TSPs can establish official signing relationships with sellers, ensuring clear communication and agreed-upon terms.

What's the workflow？

Steps

Step 1: Create a service proposal

To build an official service relationship with the seller, TSP can navigate to the Seller Management-Create Service proposal page to check authorization and create a new service proposal. Note: To ensure you can create a service proposal successfully, please ensure you have at least one approved service (Status: On) under the related category. TSP can go to the APP & Service page to double-check.

TSP can provide signing information for seller checking and signing off, which includes:

  1. Seller Information: TSP can select a seller by either shop name or shop code.

  1. Select Service Details: TSP has the option to select either a single service or multiple service categories, which include Live Management, Seller affiliate Management, Shop Management, and Short Video Management. For service proposal details, TSP needs to provide the related information as specified below. TSP also can select service group which includes all 4 seller services.

Option 1: Fill a single service proposal detail

Option 2: Batch fill multiple service proposal details: Selecting "Batch fill service proposal details" means uploading a service detail file that covers multiple services, allowing sellers to go through the approval process of proposal signing only once.

Proposal Details LIVE management Short Video management Seller affiliate management Shop management
Service period: TSP needs to choose a start and end date for the service that aligns with the actual service cycle. Required Required Required Required
Permission needed: TSP can choose the permission needed for this service, which includes:
Shop Ticket - Enable TSPs to submit a ticket on behalf of the seller
Shop-level Data analysis- Enable TSP to check seller shop-level performance on TikTok Shop Partner Center
Account-level Data analysis- Enable TSP to check seller account-level performance on TikTok Shop Partner Center (*only for Live management or short video management）
Seller Center Access - Enable TSP to log into the seller center and take further action
Seller Center Message - Enable TSP to check the seller violation message in Seller Center
Seller Center Analytics Access- Enable TSP to log into the seller center and check the data compass on TikTok Shop Partner Center		 Required

Seller's TikTok account: TSP needs to select the serviced seller account by account name Required Required No need No need
Management period: TSPs are required to select the actual management period for each TikTok account. Required Required No need No need
Affiliate GMV type: TSP needs to choose their affiliate service type, including target/open/TAP campaign No need No need Required No need
Service details: Upload various forms of documentation as proof of your service. Acceptable types include official emails from the seller, permits from the seller, service contracts, or seller invoices. Optional Optional Optional Optional
Please note: during the same period, a seller shop/account can only be signed with one TSP under the same service category. If the seller already has an existing agreement with another TSP under the same category, an error code may occur. In this case, the seller must choose only one TSP to sign with.

Step 2: Seller views and signs the proposal

After creating a service proposal, TSP can share the proposal link with the seller to sign.

When the seller opens the proposal link, they can view the service proposal, which includes basic information about the TSP and detailed service offerings across various categories. After reviewing, the seller has the option to either reject or accept the proposal. If accepted, the seller and TSP will officially be signed up for the specific service. Please note: Sellers are not able to modify the proposal. If there are any questions or concerns about the service proposal, sellers can contact TSP.

Step 3: Check and manage the sign details

After signing, the seller can go to my services page to view all signing details. By clicking View the Details, the seller can check the detailed signing information

TSP can navigate to the seller management-service proposals page to check all signing information

*How to renew the signing with the Seller？ TSPs have the option to select the 'Extend' button to create a renewal application. They can then edit the new service period. After making these adjustments, TSPs can share the signing link with the seller for review and approval.

*How to cancel the existing signing with the seller？ TSP can navigate to TikTok Shop Partner Center-> Seller Management and click delete to raise a cancel signing request.

After a TSP initiates a cancellation, the seller can view the request on the My Service page:

  1. If the seller chooses "Agree," the authorization will be canceled immediately.
  2. If the seller chooses "Reject," the authorization will remain valid. You may contact the seller or resubmit your request after 144 hours.
  3. If the seller does not respond within 72 hours, the authorization will be automatically canceled.

*Signing Status

Definition
Rejected The service proposal was rejected by the seller
Wait for confirmation Service proposals are waiting for the seller to review. TSP can cancel the proposal at this stage.
Partially confirm Part of the service proposal was accepted by TSP., TSP can check and add a new service proposal if needed.
Canceled The service proposal was canceled by TSP/Seller

Notes

  1. To ensure you can create a service proposal successfully, please make sure you have at least one live (Status "on") service under the related category. TSP can go to the My service page to double-check.
  2. During the same period, one seller shop/account can only be signed with one TSP under the same service category. If the seller already has an existing agreement with another TSP under the same category, an error code may occur. In this case, the seller must choose only one TSP to sign with.
  3. This new singing process will not affect existing authorization between TSP and the seller, but we recommend TSP to upload service details for existing authorization, especially the Live Management service.

FAQs

Why does my service proposal show an error？

During the same period, a seller shop/account can only be signed with one TSP under the same service category. Please guide your seller to check on My service page to see if there is already an existing signed service proposal.
